files.README.md:
Halcyon Transect Programme - field survey archive.

surveys/ is the programme archive. Each arena folder holds one plot
sheet per quadrat, written tab-separated by the field recorders, and
registry/ holds the compiled series the programme exports.

transfers/ is the outbound staging area: a copy of the compiled series
is written there whenever a release goes to the national data centre.
The staging copies are working files and are not part of the archive.

files.notes/field_notes.md:
Field notes - late season.

Two arenas were re-walked after the August storm; the rechecks carry
a quality flag in the compiled series. Recorder initials are unchanged.
files.notes/equipment.md:
Equipment log.

The loaned conductivity meter went back in July. Quadrat frames are
sound; two tapes were replaced during the last walk of the season.
